responsibility: Defines the Visium target command-line options and their mapping to generated GCC option variables, masks, and enums. It introduces options for CPU selection, scheduling tuning, floating-point mode, simulator/debug runtime linkage, supervisor versus user mode, and compatibility switches, and ties mcpu/mtune values to enum processor_type so the rest of the backend can select features and scheduling policy consistently.
same_name_distinction: The target option-definition file for Visium: unlike visium.cc it does not implement backend behavior, unlike visium.h it does not set target macros or assembler conventions, and unlike visium.md it does not describe RTL insns; instead it declares the -m switches, masks, and processor enums that drive the rest of the port.
